change: Score the worst array-element conversion rather than the sum, avoiding overload changes caused by literal length. Infer generic elements from typed values before scoring earlier literals, including typed spreads.
coverage: Native/web default/release: literal lengths, nested typed-array overloads, concrete narrow/floating candidates, mixed scalar/literal/spread types, deferred integer overflow, fixed-array updates, unpacking and exact numeric behavior.
limits: Existing handling of context-dependent generic elements and local-versus-standard-library overload priority is retained. This does not define a complete new generic-specificity system. Hosted CI runs the full C-bootstrap gate.
